# FLX-3514: a Kafka topic will not take the stream as it is

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The record timestamp is the event's time, and the sink never moves a record's bytes to fit a topic. A topic whose message.timestamp.type is LogAppendTime would replace event time with the time of the write, a snapshot's topic must be compacted, and a timestamp outside the topic's message.timestamp.before.max.ms or after.max.ms, or below zero, is refused by the brokers. The message names the topic and the limit. Configure the topic for the backfill (CreateTime, compaction, wider timestamp limits), choose another topic with --sink-opt topic.EXPOSE=NAME, or run a window nearer the present.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3514
```
